gen-gf-unica-one-gf-blinker: Unica One draws every stroke at a single thickness, with a huge lowercase and daylight in each curve. Blinker follows with sturdy lines and open apertures, its lowercase filling most of the height, so the sans feels as direct as the heading.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-carrois-gothic: Stark, outlined, almost stitched. Carrois Gothic takes over below with a high x-height and a generous opening in c, a plain sans that lets the heading's thin, uniform line stand out.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Every stroke in Unica One keeps one width, framing its counters like wire. Carrois Gothic SC is the quieter half, with clear curve endings and capitals barely taller than lowercase, so the heading does the shouting and the plain sans does the explaining.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-chivo: Distinctive from the first glance, Unica One has a very large lowercase eye and flat, fineliner-style lines throughout. Chivo packs its lowercase close to the caps below.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-chocolate-classical-: Modern and sizable, the lowercase here has a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut. Unica One gives it a sharp partner, with an o whose sides and top are equally thick, and the sans-serif body feels warmer beside it.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-comme: Unica One runs one unmodulated line across every glyph, and its lowercase eye is very large, with daylight in every curve. Comme keeps pace, smooth and unclogged.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-cossette-texte: Clean and wide-eyed, the body text shows off a prominent x-height and n arches as thick as their stems. Cossette Texte matches the straight-lined build of Unica One, so the sans and the display heading read like one drawing hand.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-duru-sans: Modern and clean, Duru Sans opens its small letters wide, and its bodies dominate the line while ascenders hardly show. Unica One holds a single line width throughout, and a body size a notch smaller than you'd guess keeps that sans from crowding it.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-fresca: Fresca reads modern and clean, with no calligraphic thinning, counters open to the outside, and short ascenders above big bowls. Nudging its size up gives that plain sans room to breathe.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-funnel-sans: Unica One leads with a very large lowercase eye and strokes of one thickness, daylight showing inside every curve. Funnel Sans holds its widths steady below.
